What assumptions and limits does this shipment comparison depend on?

These results apply within the following scope and assumptions.

Calculation scope

One recorded shipment commitment and the listed complete arrangements. Preference applies only among arrangements meeting every enabled mandatory requirement in every admitted operating situation.

Material assumptions
Quoted complete expense, preparation durations, capacities, calendars, access and recorded permissions remain applicable to this shipment.
Evidence interpretation determines admitted operating situations; it supplies no probability weights. A portal listing alone does not establish transportation registration.
The reservation cutoff is distinct from the delivery deadline. More information cannot improve an already irrevocable reservation.
When assessed, the information policy uses the supplied probability weights and observation model; these are assumptions, not established frequencies. The verification fee is counted once.
